text: The accepted ImapOfflineMsgStreamListener forwards OnStopRequest, retains its return as rv, clears and closes the channel, then gates DiscardOfflineMsg on the incoming stream status and mail.discard_offline_msg_on_failure. The destination callback result is a separate value and is returned after the recovery check. Keep the source-status versus consumer-return distinction in this path. Shared knowledge already covers the moved preference boundary, metadata invalidation and mbox safety. This source does not promise an immediate retry or reproduce a failed read. This is static source inspection only. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility validation ran. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion remains pending.
title: Use source stream failure status for IMAP offline recovery policy
